description: Sudoku Dash module test vectors. Cells row-major, 0=empty. Boxes: 4x4=2x2, 6x6=2 rows x 3 cols, 9x9=3x3. Tiers: 1 naked single, 2 hidden single, 3 naked/hidden pair + pointing, 4 box-line, naked/hidden triple, X-Wing. first_step = step(givens), techniques tried in order: naked_single, hidden_single (boxes, then rows, then cols), naked_pair, hidden_pair, pointing, box_line_reduction, naked_triple, hidden_triple, x_wing.
